### New in 1.7.1
- **New home on GitHub**: Shelfwise now lives at [RajkumarPadmanabhan/update-shelf](https://github.com/RajkumarPadmanabhan/update-shelf). The in-app update check, the **Latest version** button and the website all point there.
- **New website address**: https://rajkumarpadmanabhan.github.io/update-shelf/

### Install / update
Download `shelfwise.apk` below and open it. It installs over older versions and keeps all your data.
